interpretation_limit: Diagnostic copy only. Printed Unix trace-line timestamps are separate from syscall duration and monotonic phase markers. Unresolved calls and unknown main-process/exit identities stay explicit. Tracing adds overhead; an observed last mapping does not prove that mapping caused a stall or identify an unobserved import.

readahead_policy.interpretation_limit: Actual per-filesystem policy changed before restore and remained zero after preflight. This is an end-to-end policy observation, not an isolated Lean-only A/B measurement, a proof export, or a unique causal attribution. Demand faults, compressed-extent reads and other kernel paths remain possible.

native_step_order.name: Create the unchanged bounded logical proofstore
Require direct I/O only for the new owned proofstore loop
Set only the new owned Btrfs filesystem readahead to zero
Authenticate all 444 original archives and read back 25191 projected objects
Require exactly the original BothLong endpoint to remain uncompiled
Confirm the owned filesystem readahead stayed zero after preflight
Observe the isolated diagnostic copy with unchanged strict kernel limits

transport_retry_observations.interpretation_limit: No transport records means none of these structured records was observed. The helper emits no successful-GET record or artifact ID; retry decisions and wait records do not count successful retries. Full original archive/source/receipt/trace checks remain separate and mandatory.
